title: Restore locally editable Callaway chart editing and usage

requirements.summary: Restore the Admin Callaway chart editor UI when Admin Access is enabled (show editor instead of locked backend-managed messaging).
acceptanceCriteria: With Admin Access disabled, /admin continues to show the existing "Admin Access Disabled" card and Settings navigation.

With Admin Access enabled, /admin renders the CallawayChartEditor (18-hole and 9-hole tabs, editable grid, Save Changes, Reset to Defaults) and does not show messaging that chart editing is moved to the backend.
All user-facing text on the /admin page is in English.

file_operations.description: Replace the admin-enabled locked/centrally-managed chart card with the editable Admin UI by rendering CallawayChartEditor. Keep the Admin Access disabled state unchanged (existing disabled card + Settings navigation). Use existing shadcn-ui Card/Button layout primitives for consistency; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Confirm the editor can be embedded as the primary /admin content (no reliance on removed locked-state UI). Keep user-facing text English and aligned with the restored admin workflow; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Make calculations and leaderboard chart display use the locally editable (localStorage-backed) Callaway chart so saved edits affect results and rendering no longer blocks on backend chart loading.
acceptanceCriteria: Editing chart values in the CallawayChartEditor and clicking "Save Changes" changes the chart used by the app when calculating results in LeaderboardView.
LeaderboardView no longer blocks results rendering solely due to failure to load the backend chart; it can calculate and display results using the locally editable chart.
The chart shown in the leaderboard "Callaway Scoring Chart" section reflects the same chart data being used for calculations (including any saved edits).

file_operations.description: Stop hard-blocking results on backend chart availability. Source the chart used for calculations from the localStorage-backed chart persistence layer (matching the event's holeCount) and ensure calculations re-run when users save chart edits. Keep any backend chart fetch (if retained) as optional/fallback but not a blocker; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update the calculation utility to accept and use the locally editable chart representation (from the local chart persistence layer) for deduction/adjustment lookup, while keeping behavior consistent for 9/18 holes. Ensure the returned metadata (row label / worst holes used) matches the chart being applied.

Change the chart display component to render the same locally editable chart data that is used by calculations (including any saved edits), instead of assuming a backend-provided SharedChartEntry array. Continue using existing shadcn-ui Card/Table components for layout; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add/adjust a small helper (or exported accessor) that provides the exact chart shape needed by both calculations and CallawayChartSection (derived from the active local grid chart for 9/18 holes), so both consumers share a single source of truth.

requirements.summary: Remove UI copy implying the Callaway chart is backend-locked/centrally managed and ensure Admin Access settings text remains accurate.
acceptanceCriteria: The Admin panel no longer shows text stating "The Callaway scoring chart is now managed by the backend system" or similar locked/centralized-management messaging.
The app’s Settings description for Admin Access remains accurate (admin features include the Callaway chart editor).

file_operations.description: Remove any remaining locked/centralized-management messaging and any copy implying users must contact a system administrator to change the chart. Ensure /admin copy is English-only and consistent with local editability; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Verify the Admin Access description remains accurate after restoring the editor (admin features include the Callaway chart editor) and adjust wording only if needed to match the restored behavior; verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
